title: TransitEye Canonical Detection Schema
description: Schema for physical road observations: road defects, waterlogging, and VRU/safety risks

id.description: Unique identifier for the detection observation (UUID or formatted ID)

type.description: High-level domain category of the detection

subtype.description: Specific detection label (e.g. pothole, crack, deep_water, pedestrian_hazard)

segment_id.description: Optional GIS road segment identifier if matched

confirmed_by_count.description: Number of confirming passes or buses validating this observation

thumbnail_url.description: URI or reference path to an image thumbnail/evidence snapshot

metadata.description: Stream-specific attributes (e.g. bounding box, depth estimate, sensor fusion details)
